svg.title: Clear / Purge / Destroy comparison
svg.desc: Choose based on sensitivity, media and intended use; these are not mandatory sequential stages.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Goal: resist simple, non-invasive data recovery. Apply appropriate
logical sanitization to user-accessible storage. Example: overwrite
user-addressable data through standard read/write interfaces on
Goal: make recovery of target data infeasible even with advanced
laboratory techniques. Use logical or physical techniques appropriate
to the media, potentially preserving reuse. Examples: qualifying
device sanitization commands and Cryptographic Erase.
Goal: make recovery with advanced laboratory techniques infeasible and
render the media unable to store data. Use media-appropriate physical
destruction. Examples: media shredding to suitable specifications,
disintegration or other approved destruction techniques.
